newsitem.title: UK: European vgo gains with crude, U.S interest cautio.
newsitem.headline: European vgo gains with crude, U.S interest cautio.

text.p: European vacuum gas oil was marginally firmer on Friday tracking stronger crude.
Interest for low sulphur material was seen from the U.S, but few suppliers had sufficient volume to make up a suitable cargo size and the arbitrage was not open.
"It is not clear enough and crude has been volatile lately," said one trader.

A p+c low sulphur barge was sold into Germany. Small parcels of 10kt apiece were heard for November. U.S. demand may come in more forcefully for mid November material which could give some underlying support.
